bouhertma-fieldclimate.title: Jendouba GDA Bouhertma FieldClimate station observations
bouhertma-fieldclimate.organization: Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Hydraulic Resources and Fisheries
bouhertma-fieldclimate.limitation: Hourly reported irradiance at the station in W/m². The archive has gaps and does not specify a timezone. Photovoltaic generation and irrigation demand require additional inputs.

demo-site.title: Jendouba pilot site
demo-site.limitation: The irrigation group, plots and equipment are fictional. The coordinates locate the demo.

wapor.title: WaPOR trial in Jendouba · daily ETa at 10 m resolution
wapor.limitation: The plots and indicators are simulated. ETa measures evapotranspiration. Well withdrawals require meter readings.

solar.title: Solar PV potential in Tunisia
solar.limitation: Regional context. Both hourly demo profiles are synthetic. The site needs a survey and a grid connection study.

wind.title: Global Wind Atlas · Tunisia
wind.limitation: Local wind data and a turbine model are needed to estimate production.

telemetry.title: Demo water and energy readings
telemetry.limitation: Higher consumption or unaccounted-for water warrants a check. Further measurements are needed to establish the cause.

weather.title: Ensemble forecasts and uncertainty
weather.limitation: Both hourly profiles are simulated. Local day-ahead forecast records are unavailable.

ins-households.title: RGPH 2024 · Ménages
ins-households.limitation: This census describes households and their main water source. It provides no irrigation withdrawal or private borehole measurements.

sonede-distribution.title: Exploitation et distribution de l’eau
sonede-distribution.limitation: The figures describe public drinking-water distribution. They do not quantify the pilot's irrigation deliveries or explain a specific outage.

groundwater-kebili.title: Nappes profondes · Kébili
groundwater-kebili.organization: Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries
groundwater-kebili.limitation: The records cover deep aquifers in Kébili. They cannot establish Jendouba borehole conditions.

dgre-aquifers.title: Rapport sur les Indicateurs de Développement Durable
dgre-aquifers.organization: Tunisian Ministry of Environment · DGRE data
dgre-aquifers.limitation: The DGRE series is a historical national aggregate for deep aquifers. It does not establish a local borehole's condition or permitted withdrawal.

world-bank-irrigation.title: Tunisia: Major Push to Strengthen Water Security and Resilience
world-bank-irrigation.limitation: This announcement states project commitments. It does not verify site-level improvements or irrigation outcomes.

jendouba-borehole.title: Jendouba pilot borehole measurements
jendouba-borehole.limitation: No observed water level, pumping test or metered withdrawal is available for a pilot borehole.

pvgis-sarah3-jendouba-2023.title: PVGIS-SARAH3 hourly PV estimates at the Jendouba reference point
pvgis-sarah3-jendouba-2023.limitation: Hourly estimates for hypothetical 10 kWp systems use PVGIS power samples as representative of each hour. Separate rooftop and canopy request URLs and raw exports accompany the local archive. Site surveys, metered loads and installation costs are unavailable.

site-pvgis.title: Site-level photovoltaic yield and loads
site-pvgis.limitation: The demo solar options lack a measured facility load, installation survey and verified annual costs. Separate archived PVGIS-SARAH3 profiles estimate production at the Jendouba reference point.
